no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee (AC) meeting held to discuss this NDA as there were no issues that required discussion at an AC meeting.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Trulance (plecanatide) NDA 208745. The Summary Review, Office Director Memo, and Medical Review all independently state that no AC meeting was held because the application did not raise safety or efficacy issues requiring committee discussion for a drug in this class. Consequently there are no AC-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
